# Edgewood Catskills

Edgewood Catskills is a 22-acre wilderness retreat in Hunter, New York, with a small collection of cabins and tents. Open May 1 through October 31.

- Official website: https://edgewoodcatskills.com/
- About: https://edgewoodcatskills.com/about
- Guest FAQ: https://edgewoodcatskills.com/faq
- Contact: https://edgewoodcatskills.com/contact
- Booking and live availability: https://book.edgewoodcatskills.com/

Bookings, rates and cancellation terms must be verified through the live booking service.
